text: I think you'll really enjoy this Pineapple Chicken Salad Sandwich recipe, given your love for chicken and gluten-free requirements. The ingredients are easily sourced and can be prepared in under 15 minutes, fitting your time budget. The combination of chicken, pineapple, and cream cheese provides a good balance of protein and flavor, aligning with your health goal of higher protein intake. The recipe also doesn't contain any gluten-containing ingredients, making it suitable for your dietary needs.
